'''''Marauder''''' was a [[Warrior-class gunship|''Warrior''-class gunship]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Defense Fleet]], [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Hannser]].

The ''Marauder'' had been sent to intercept the [[Teljkon Vagabond]] as part of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ejagga Pakkpekatt|Pakkpekatt's]] fleet. Some time later, the ''Marauder'' aided the [[Indomitable (Majestic-class)|''Indomitable'']] in eliminating a [[Yevetha]]n [[Aramadia-class thrustship|T-type thrustship]] in the [[Battle of ILC-905]].
